Cover, darkness, distance, and the frantic dodging of a target who knows what is coming: you have stopped regarding any of it as relevant. You decide where the shot lands, and then it lands there.

1st Level

  • Your ranged Strikes and spell attacks ignore the flat check from concealment and take no circumstance penalty from cover less than greater cover.
  • Range increments for your ranged weapons and spells double.
  • When you hit the same creature with a second or later ranged Strike or spell attack in the same round, that attack ignores the target's resistances.

5th Level

  • Gain Aim.
    • Aim [free action, once per round] Your next ranged Strike or spell attack this turn treats a failure as a success.

10th Level

  • Ignore greater cover entirely.
  • Target creatures you can sense but not see with no flat check.

15th Level

  • Aim has no frequency limit.
  • Your ranged Strikes and spell attacks cannot be blocked, redirected, or targeted by reactions.

Aim upgrades a failure only. A critical failure still misses.

In Foundry: your ranged weapons' range increments are doubled on the sheet. From 5th, switch Aim on in your effects panel before the attack: a failed ranged Strike or spell attack is a success on the roll. Switch it off after, once per round until 15th.

For the table: spell ranges (double the printed range), the concealment flat check (skip it), cover penalties (do not apply them; from 10th not even greater cover), targeting a creature you sense but cannot see, ignoring resistance on a second hit, and the reaction immunity from 15th. A note on every ranged attack lists them.
